about_the_game:
Manage a restaurant... by throwing everything within reach! Sling It! Serve It! is a top-down action-management game where you play as a server unlike any other. Your job? Seat the clients, and serve them their meals—by tossing everything across the dining room!

In this organized chaos, every throw matters. Launch your guests with precision, send the right dish before their patience runs out, and adapt to the unique challenges of each restaurant around the globe. From moving gondolas in Italy, to rails in Mexico, and folding screens in Japan—every country brings its own twists.

Developed by a small independent team, Sling It! Serve It! combines humor, fast-paced action, and strategy into an experience that’s as funny as it is demanding.

Features:

  • Throw-based gameplay: Tables, clients, plates—nothing is safe from your hands.

  • Restaurants from around the world: Each chapter introduces unique mechanics and culinary vibes.

  • Fast-paced, replayable levels: Serve as many guests as you can within the time limit to earn 5 stars.

  • Precision chaos: Behind the jokes and the mess lies a true test of skill and coordination.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 ou équivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 260X (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
